claims.claim: The rider was charged SGD 15.00 despite an initial fixed quote of SGD 10.00, resulting in an unverified SGD 5.00 fare increase.
The rider explicitly queried the deviation and stated they did not request a longer route, demonstrating lack of rider approval for the detour.
The sampled route excess ratio of 1.000255 exceeds the 0.25 review trigger threshold under policy, necessitating formal review rather than an automatic charge adjustment.

Under team-authored synthetic policy rules, when material justifications such as traffic or safety cannot be verified, the missing evidence must be reported for human review before confirming or refunding the excess charge.
